The reaction mixture was vortexed for 3 min and then let stand at room temperature for 24 h. The mixture was then loaded onto 1.5 g of a Strong Anion Exchange (Quaternary Amine) resin and eluted with 20 mL of CH2Cl2 followed by 10 mL of 3% TFA in CH2Cl2 to give 5g as a white solid. A carboxylic acid, N-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)-N'-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride (1.1- 1.4 equiv), and benzotriazole-1-ol (1.1-1.4 equiv) were combined in a reaction vial and DMF was added (0.1-0.6 mmol acid/ mL).
